best_for: Students interested in the future of technology
Creative thinkers who like experimenting with new tools
not_for: Kids looking for deep mathematical programming

prerequisites.required: Basic computer and internet navigation skills.

system_requirements.hardware: A computer or tablet with a webcam and microphone.
system_requirements.software_accounts: Modern web browser. Parent consent for specific AI tool accounts.

overview.positioning: A fun, safe, and hands-on introduction to Artificial Intelligence and machine learning.
overview.short_description: Discover the magic of AI! Teach a computer to recognize your face, play drawing games with neural networks, and learn how to use AI tools safely to spark your creativity.

key_facts.capstone: Train Your Own Custom AI Model

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Train a computer to recognize images and sounds
Write creative prompts for AI chatbots and art generators
Discuss the ethics of AI in a simple, kid-friendly way

why_now.industry_shift: AI is becoming a part of everyday life and work.
why_now.ai_impact: Understanding AI early prevents fear and builds mastery.
why_now.business_demand: AI literacy will be as important as computer literacy.
why_now.career_opportunity: Fosters early interest in data science and machine learning.

learning_outcomes: UNDERSTAND: Explain basic AI concepts without complex math.
TRAIN: Use Teachable Machine to create image recognition models.
PROMPT: Interact effectively with text and image AI generators.
EVALUATE: Identify ethical and safe uses of AI technology.

stages.focus: Building actual models using Teachable Machine.
Using AI as a partner for writing and art.

core_tools.what_student_learns: Data collection, training, and testing models

core_tools.tool: Kid-safe Chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT via guided platforms)

stages.name: Collect Data
stages.desc: Taking pictures or recording sounds to teach the AI.

stages.name: Train
stages.desc: Letting the computer analyze the data.

stages.name: Test
stages.desc: Seeing if the AI learned correctly.

ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: The human need to provide good data.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Central theme of the course (AI ethics).

best_practices: Provide lots of diverse data when training an AI.
Be specific and clear when writing prompts for chatbots.
Always remember that AI can make mistakes (hallucinations).

common_mistakes.mistake: Providing bad data to a model.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Ensure lighting is good and backgrounds are varied when training image models.
Remember it's a tool predicting words, not a thinking being.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Basic understanding of how AI models are trained.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: Completed AI models and prompt portfolios.

freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Links to trained Teachable Machine models.

what_you_will_build: A model that detects if you are smiling or frowning
A gallery of AI-generated digital art
final_deliverables: A final project showcasing a custom trained model and a presentation on how it works.

assessment.criteria: Ability to train a working model and explain the basic concept of how it learned.

certification.title: Junior AI Explorer Certificate
certification.criteria: Complete the Teachable Machine capstone project.

not_covered: Python programming for AI, math behind neural networks.

faq.question: Is this safe for kids?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We use heavily vetted, kid-friendly platforms and emphasize safe, supervised interaction.

faq.question: Will they learn to code in this class?
faq.answer: This class focuses on AI concepts, data training, and prompt engineering rather than typing code.

modules.module_purpose: Demystify AI and show how it recognizes patterns.
what_you_will_learn: What AI is and where it is used

lessons.what_is_taught: Definition of AI, real-world examples (Netflix, Siri).
lessons.what_learner_does: Identifies AI in their daily lives.

lessons.why_it_matters: Shows that AI learns from lots of examples.
lessons.what_learner_does: Plays QuickDraw and analyzes how the AI guesses their drawings.

lessons.what_is_taught: Why AI sometimes gets things wrong.
lessons.what_learner_does: Reviews funny or interesting AI mistakes and discusses why they happened.

modules.hands_on_practice: Play AI-based web games and record how they react.
modules.assignment: Submit a short reflection on a time the AI guessed wrong in QuickDraw.
modules.expected_outcome: Solid foundational knowledge of what AI is.

modules.module_purpose: Hands-on experience creating a machine learning model.

lessons.what_is_taught: The interface of Google Teachable Machine.
lessons.why_it_matters: It's the most accessible tool for creating real ML models.

lessons.what_is_taught: Collecting webcam data for different classes.
lessons.why_it_matters: Teaches how data inputs create outcomes.
lessons.what_learner_does: Trains a model to distinguish between them holding an apple or a banana.

lessons.what_is_taught: The importance of varied data (lighting, angles).
lessons.why_it_matters: Teaches how to fix bias and improve accuracy.
lessons.what_learner_does: Retrains their model with more diverse images to make it smarter.

lessons.why_it_matters: Expands understanding of what data can be.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a model that recognizes clapping vs. snapping.

modules.assignment: Submit the link to a trained Teachable Machine model.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to train and test custom ML models.

modules.module_purpose: Explore how AI can generate text and art, focusing on prompt engineering.

lessons.what_is_taught: How to ask an AI for exactly what you want.
lessons.why_it_matters: A crucial skill for using future tools.
lessons.what_learner_does: Practices getting a chatbot to write a story in the style of a pirate.

lessons.why_it_matters: Shows the intersection of tech and art.
lessons.what_learner_does: Generates images of imaginative creatures (e.g., 'a cat riding a skateboard on Mars').
Discusses when it's okay to use AI for homework and when it isn't.
Presents their favorite trained model or generated project to the class.

modules.hands_on_practice: Use AI to co-write a comic book script and generate the character art.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to use Generative AI creatively and ethically.
